output.reason: I didn't rewrite this one because the code never moves money. It has no charge, refund, payment, purchase, payout or credit. It looks up the restaurant's website if no URL is given, scrapes the menu, searches for the location to pick a tax rate (13% for Canada, 8.5% otherwise), and returns a preview with that rate. Since there's no money movement to leave out, a rewritten description wouldn't really be missing anything the code does, and labeling the example as a mismatch would be wrong.
